first_information_report.brief_facts: On 20-11-2024 at about 14:30 hours, the accused Ravi Shankar Yadav, a former security guard of Rishi Apartments who was dismissed on 05-09-2024, entered the building premises and using an iron rod, broke open the Godrej padlock of Flat 302 belonging to complainant Vikram Malhotra, and committed house-breaking and theft of gold ornaments, silver articles, and cash totaling approximately ₹18,45,000. The accused was captured on CCTV cameras of the building. During investigation, the accused was arrested on 22-11-2024 and stolen gold ornaments worth ₹6,80,000, cash ₹85,000, and iron rod used in offence were recovered from his possession and at his instance. Case registered.
first_information_report.action_taken: Case registered under relevant sections. Accused arrested. Stolen property partially recovered. Forensic examination conducted. CCTV footage seized.
